notes: 0.06 keep-incentive backing B = 64,896,174,863,380,000 wei (PURCHASER_GAS_PRICE 2 gwei), matching the final contract; see backing_by_gps_gwei['2']['r1_06']['backing_wei'].

Checkpoint pay: this cash path prices a checkpoint at the flat Q_CHECKPOINT=360,000 gas (policy.Q['checkpoint']) plus one work fee. The final contract adds 6,000 gas per allocation-queue entry read and 30,000 per FWA listing read, at most 32 entries, usually 0-2 at a checkpoint. At 0.5 gwei that is at most ~0.00058 ETH and usually <0.00004 ETH extra per checkpoint; checkpoints fire only on holder flows (~2 over a run: price the deposit, price the exit), so the omission shifts every recipe's annual return by well under 0.01% and does not change any ranking. It is request-funded (holder-paid), equal across recipes.

Every recipe uses the current keep-incentive backing rule with the live token-bid discount 9150 bps; r2/r3 (0.03 packs, three 0.01 Shapes) price the purchaser redeem at 195,000 gas (160,000 measured for a 2-Shape pack + 35,000 derived per Shape, not fork-measured). The effect on 0.03 backing versus 160,000 is ~7e-5 ETH, immaterial.
